content.title: A busy holiday season is coming!
content.body: Like clockwork, October 1st is a bit of a rude awakening each year as the limited days to prepare for a busy holiday season become all too clear.  Despite the pressure, I always seem to get done what needs to get done.  It's always a pleasure to see so many familiar customer faces that think of my work for their gifts.  I hope to see you at some point in the next few months and if I look a bit tired then remind me that i get to rest in January!

image.alt: Busy times in my little studio
